This issuer demonstrates strong scale with over $9 billion in quarterly revenue and a solid operating margin of 10%, generating healthy positive net income. Liquidity is adequate with a current ratio of 1.39, though leverage is moderately high with total liabilities representing roughly 71% of total assets, which constrains the rating slightly below the top tiers. Therefore, an investment-grade rating in the mid-to-lower tier is appropriate.

DECISION: BBB+
